note: xmlDumpElementContent() (valid.c) dereferences content->c1->type and content->c2->type in both its SEQ and OR branches with no NULL check. content's children are built by xmlParseElementChildrenContentDeclPriv() (parser.c), which links a freshly-parsed sub-content node onto the tree only when that sub-parse succeeded (e.g. `if ((cur != NULL) && (last != NULL)) cur->c2 = last;`); when a nested content-model sub-parse fails while parsing a malformed DTD element-content declaration in recovery mode, the assignment is skipped and the child pointer is left unset, so a later dump of that DTD dereferences it.
